```{r}
#| label: setup
#| results: false
source("setup.R")
fits <- get_fits()
```

# Price elasticity

```{r}
#| label: tbl-elasticity
#| tbl-cap: "Price elasticity and the % change in packs per person for a 10% higher real price."
bind_rows(lapply(specs$model, function(m) {
  as_draws_df(fits[[m]], variable = "b_log_rprice_c") |>
    mutate_variables(pct_10 = 100 * (1.1^b_log_rprice_c - 1)) |>
    summarise_draws("mean", "sd", "mcse_mean", ~quantile2(.x, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))) |>
    mutate(model = m, .before = 1)
})) |>
  kable(digits = 3)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-elasticity
#| fig-cap: "Posterior of the price elasticity in each model."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4
bind_rows(lapply(specs$model, function(m) {
  tibble(model = m, b = as_draws_df(fits[[m]], variable = "b_log_rprice_c")$b_log_rprice_c)
})) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = b, y = model)) +
  stat_halfeye() +
  labs(x = "Price elasticity", y = NULL)
```

# State-specific elasticities

```{r}
#| label: fig-state-elasticity
#| fig-cap: "State-specific price elasticities in M2b (posterior mean and 90% interval). Solid: M2b population mean; dashed: pooled M1b."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 8
coef(fits$M2b, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))$state[, , "log_rprice_c"] |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("state") |>
  mutate(state = reorder(state, Estimate)) |>
  ggplot(aes(Estimate, state)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = fixef(fits$M2b)["log_rprice_c", "Estimate"]) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = fixef(fits$M1b)["log_rprice_c", "Estimate"], linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = Q5, xmax = Q95), size = 0.2) +
  labs(x = "Price elasticity", y = "State") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))
```

# Coefficients

```{r}
#| label: fig-m2b-areas
#| fig-cap: "Marginal posteriors of the M2b population-level coefficients."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4
mcmc_areas(as_draws_df(fits$M2b),
           pars = c("b_log_rprice_c", "b_log_rpimin_c", "b_log_rincome_c", "b_year_c"),
           prob_outer = 0.98)
```
